params.command: $paths=@("$env:USERPROFILE\local-ai-workspaces\mhw-mods","$env:USERPROFILE\mhw-mods"); foreach($p in $paths){ if(Test-Path (Join-Path $p '.git')){ Write-Output "REPO=$p"; git -C $p fetch origin main --prune; Write-Output ('HEAD='+(git -C $p rev-parse HEAD)); Write-Output ('BRANCH='+(git -C $p branch --show-current)); Write-Output ('ORIGIN_MAIN='+(git -C $p rev-parse origin/main)); git -C $p status --short; break } }
